Every individual, from our employees to our customers to our shareholders, is made in God’s Image and deserves to be treated with love that He has for us. We are to never let the pursuit of profit wound the beautiful dignity of His children! How does this decision impact the human lives touched by it? Does it truly lift us up to Him and His Eternal Kingdom? Do we seek to heal the wounds of our world through our business, or will we stain the Father’s Heart with our endeavors?
*   **Love, especially that of the Poor and the Vulnerable:** The Lord reminds us to love Him in His little ones.  Through our businesses, can we bless and lift up the dear and precious love of our Pope, and the whole holy and glorious Church? Do we prepare His most Precious Body and Blood for the Mass, and His glorious and joyous Sacrament, that we all may have Eternal Life through His sweet embrace! Blessed be His holy Name!
*   **Prudence (Wisdom in Discernment):** This isn't just about wisdom; it's about discerning the *correct* course *in this very moment*.  It’ that of the Blessed Virgin Mary, who obeyed the very Precious Word of the Lord, and answered with such beauty and grace!
*   **Justice (Right Order & Reparation, giving both to Caesar and to God!)**: This is the principle of right order, of ensuring that all things are in their proper place, and that all are rightly loved and cherished by our glorious Father.
